## Kanban Task
- t_54fe371c: https://hmc.sololink.cloud/#/tasks?task=t_54fe371c

## Scope
- Surface authenticated, profile/session-bound read-only worker routing capability in guided, legacy desktop, and mobile model choosers.
- Current Hermes v0.21.5 reports unsupported_runtime and exposes no inert map selector or mutation. Unexpected available/error/stale/foreign responses also fail closed. Existing chat model preferences and profile boundaries are unchanged.
- Recover the prior ten-file candidate onto current main; fix the legacy summary browser locator and Node React test-runner MessagePort non-exit.

## Verification
- npm run lint
- npm run test:worker-routing-status (Chromium fixture interactions at 1100px, 390px, 320px)
- npm run test:chat-custom-model
- npm run test:chat-model-catalog
- npm run test:chat-model-preferences
- npm run build:web; git diff --check

## Limitations / release gate
No verified Hermes worker-map read/write/resume/rollback contract exists; no positive route-write or resumed-session claims. Browser tests use a local authenticated-capability fixture, not a live owner session; Tauri desktop-local/server and deployed authenticated acceptance remain unverified for Orion integration. No deployment or paid-provider fallback requested. Repository name is public but GitHub visibility is currently PRIVATE.
